title: Premium cart design refinement
summary: Warm ivory surfaces, refined forest-green typography and larger product presentation.

changes.detail: Refined palette, card shapes, typography, address sizing, promotion field and summary. Increased product image area and moved category above product title.
Moved favourite and remove controls beneath the image with 44px targets; refined quantity controls.
Display current cart total in the persistent continue-to-payment button.
Removed the divider between address and order sections.
